title: C++ Signal Handling
description: Signal handling with <csignal>: installing handlers, raise(), the SIG_IGN and SIG_DFL sentinels, async-signal-safety, and the portability limits of std::signal.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 以 <csignal> 處理訊號：安裝處理函式、raise()、SIG_IGN 與 SIG_DFL 兩個哨兵值、非同步訊號安全，以及 std::signal 的可攜性限制。

questions.prompt: Which header declares std::signal, std::raise and the SIGINT family of macros?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個標頭檔宣告了 std::signal、std::raise 與 SIGINT 這組巨集？

explanation.zh-Hant: <csignal> 提供 std::signal、std::raise、SIG_* 巨集與 std::sig_atomic_t；C++ 標準庫沒有 <signal> 這個標頭。

options.text: <csignal>
<signal>
<thread>
<cstdlib>

questions.explanation: <csignal> declares std::signal, std::raise, the SIG* macros and std::sig_atomic_t. There is no standard <signal> header, <thread> is for concurrency, and <cstdlib> covers general utilities.

questions.prompt: What is the required signature of a handler installed with std::signal?

prompt.zh-Hant: 用 std::signal 安裝的處理函式必須是甚麼簽名？

explanation.zh-Hant: 處理函式回傳 void 並接受一個 int，該 int 就是收到的訊號編號，例如 SIGINT。

options.text: void handler(int)
int handler(int)
void handler()
int handler(void)

questions.explanation: The handler returns void and takes one int, the signal number, for example SIGINT. std::signal enforces that type: std::signal(SIGINT, handler).

a.zh-Hant: 把 SIGTERM 送給目前這個程式，因此執行已安裝的處理函式或預設動作。

b.zh-Hant: 丟出一個型別為 SIGTERM 的 C++ 例外。

c.zh-Hant: 依 pid 把訊號送給另一個行程。

d.zh-Hant: 為呼叫的執行緒封鎖 SIGTERM。

explanation.zh-Hant: raise 把訊號送給目前行程（POSIX 下是呼叫的執行緒）；要送給其他行程需用 kill。

options.text: It sends SIGTERM to the current program, which runs its handler or the default action.
It throws a C++ exception of type SIGTERM.
It sends the signal to another process identified by pid.
It blocks SIGTERM for the calling thread.

questions.explanation: raise delivers the signal to the current program, so the installed handler or the default action runs immediately. Reaching another process is the job of kill on POSIX.

prompt.zh-Hant: 執行 std::signal(SIGINT, SIG_IGN) 之後會怎樣？

a.zh-Hant: SIGINT 被忽略：不呼叫處理函式，也不執行預設動作。

b.zh-Hant: SIGINT 的預設動作被還原。

c.zh-Hant: 對 SIGINT 啟動一個新執行緒。

d.zh-Hant: SIGINT 被封鎖，直到下一次呼叫 signal()。

explanation.zh-Hant: SIG_IGN 是「忽略」哨兵值，會抑制預設動作；要還原預設動作則傳 SIG_DFL。

options.text: SIGINT is ignored: no handler runs and the default action is suppressed.
The default action for SIGINT is restored.
A new thread is started for SIGINT.
SIGINT is blocked until the next signal() call.

questions.explanation: SIG_IGN is the ignore sentinel: the signal is discarded and the default action never happens. SIG_DFL is the opposite sentinel and restores the default behaviour.

questions.prompt: Which of these are standard signal macros declared in <csignal>? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 <csignal> 中宣告的標準訊號巨集？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: SIGINT、SIGTERM、SIGSEGV 都是標準訊號；標準另外還有 SIGABRT、SIGFPE、SIGILL 等，但沒有 SIGTHREAD。

options.text: SIGINT
SIGTERM
SIGSEGV
SIGTHREAD

questions.explanation: The standard defines SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGSEGV, SIGABRT, SIGFPE and SIGILL among others. SIGTHREAD is invented and does not exist.

questions.prompt: Which statements about signal handlers are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於訊號處理函式，下列哪些敘述正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: C++ 標準只保證極少數操作在處理函式內是安全的。

b.zh-Hant: 以 std::signal 安裝的處理函式必須是 void handler(int) 形式。

c.zh-Hant: 處理函式可以自由呼叫 malloc、printf 與 std::mutex::lock。

d.zh-Hant: POSIX 定義了更長的非同步訊號安全清單，其中包含 write()。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標準只保證極少數操作安全；POSIX 另外列出 async-signal-safe 函式（含 write）。malloc、printf、鎖與 std::cout 都不在其中，在處理函式中呼叫可能死鎖或毀損狀態。

options.text: The C++ standard only guarantees a narrow set of operations that are safe inside a handler.
A handler installed with std::signal must have the form void handler(int).
A handler may freely call malloc, printf and std::mutex::lock.
POSIX defines a longer async-signal-safe list that includes write().

questions.explanation: The standard guarantees very little inside a handler, and POSIX extends that with its async-signal-safe function list, which includes write(). malloc, printf, std::cout and mutex operations are not safe because the handler may have interrupted the same library code.

questions.prompt: Unless a handler or SIG_IGN is installed, the default action for SIGINT is to terminate the program.

prompt.zh-Hant: 若沒有安裝處理函式或 SIG_IGN，SIGINT 的預設動作就是終止程式。

explanation.zh-Hant: SIGINT（通常是 Ctrl+C）的預設動作是終止程式；有些訊號的預設動作是忽略，例如 SIGCHLD。

questions.explanation: The default action for SIGINT, typically produced by Ctrl+C, is abnormal termination. Other signals differ: SIGCHLD is ignored by default, which is why the default action must be checked per signal.

questions.prompt: std::signal behaves identically on every platform, so a handler written for Linux is guaranteed to behave the same way on Windows.

prompt.zh-Hant: std::signal 在各平台上行為完全相同，因此為 Linux 寫的處理函式在 Windows 上保證行為一致。

explanation.zh-Hant: std::signal 的行為有許多實作定義的細節，例如被中斷的系統呼叫是否重啟、可否重設處理函式；跨平台應用通常改用 sigaction（POSIX）或平台專屬機制。

questions.explanation: std::signal leaves many details implementation-defined, such as whether interrupted system calls restart or whether the handler is reset on delivery. Portable code usually prefers POSIX sigaction or a platform-specific API.

questions.prompt: Passing ____ as the handler restores the default action for a signal.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把 ____ 當作處理函式傳入，可以還原某個訊號的預設動作。

explanation.zh-Hant: SIG_DFL 代表預設動作，SIG_IGN 代表忽略；兩者都是 <csignal> 提供的哨兵值。

questions.explanation: SIG_DFL is the sentinel for the default action, while SIG_IGN means ignore. Both are provided by <csignal> and passed as the second argument of std::signal.

questions.prompt: Why should a signal handler avoid std::cout, malloc and mutex locks?

prompt.zh-Hant: 為何訊號處理函式應該避免使用 std::cout、malloc 與互斥鎖？

model.zh-Hant: 訊號可能在程式任意一點中斷，甚至正好中斷在它想呼叫的那個程式庫函式內部。此時只有非同步訊號安全的操作才可用，否則處理函式可能死鎖或破壞內部狀態。可攜的做法是在處理函式中只設定 volatile std::sig_atomic_t 旗標，真正的工作留給主迴圈。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在於處理函式是「插隊」執行的，不能假設任何程式庫狀態一致。

answer.model: A signal can interrupt the program at any point, possibly in the middle of the very library call the handler wants to use. Only async-signal-safe operations are permitted; otherwise the handler may deadlock or corrupt internal state. The portable pattern is to set a volatile std::sig_atomic_t flag and do the real work in the main loop.

questions.explanation: The handler runs asynchronously, so it cannot assume that any library state is consistent when it arrives.
